results.title: One month's GMV and orders by city (KPI / dashboard month filter)
results.before_sql: SELECT city_key, count(*), sum(gmv) FROM perf.fact_orders_noidx WHERE created_date_key BETWEEN 20251101 AND 20251130 GROUP BY city_key
results.after_sql: SELECT city_key, count(*), sum(gmv) FROM core.fact_orders WHERE created_date_key BETWEEN 20251101 AND 20251130 GROUP BY city_key

results.title: Customer order history, latest 20 orders (customer 360 / support lookup)
results.before_sql: SELECT order_id, created_at, order_status, gmv FROM perf.fact_orders_noidx WHERE customer_key = 14705 ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 20
results.after_sql: SELECT order_id, created_at, order_status, gmv FROM core.fact_orders WHERE customer_key = 14705 ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 20

results.title: Hourly delivered events in a 7-day window (ops monitoring)
results.design: Monthly range partitions on event_at (pruning) + index (event_type, event_at)
results.before_sql: SELECT date_trunc('hour', event_at) AS h, count(*) FROM perf.fact_order_events_heap WHERE event_type = 'delivered' AND event_at >= '2025-06-01 00:00+07' AND event_at < '2025-06-08 00:00+07' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
results.after_sql: SELECT date_trunc('hour', event_at) AS h, count(*) FROM core.fact_order_events WHERE event_type = 'delivered' AND event_at >= '2025-06-01 00:00+07' AND event_at < '2025-06-08 00:00+07' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

results.title: One courier's active days in a quarter (gaps-and-islands input)
results.design: Partial index on fact_order_events(courier_key, event_date_key) WHERE courier_key IS NOT NULL
results.before_sql: SELECT DISTINCT event_date_key FROM perf.fact_order_events_heap WHERE courier_key = 10 AND event_date_key BETWEEN 20250701 AND 20250930
results.after_sql: SELECT DISTINCT event_date_key FROM core.fact_order_events WHERE courier_key = 10 AND event_date_key BETWEEN 20250701 AND 20250930

results.title: 24-month GMV / completion trend for all cities (dashboard landing view)
results.design: Pre-aggregated periodic snapshot mart.city_daily instead of scanning the fact
results.before_sql: SELECT d.year_month, count(*), count(*) FILTER (WHERE f.is_delivered), sum(f.gmv) FROM perf.fact_orders_noidx f JOIN core.dim_date d ON d.date_key = f.created_date_key GROUP BY d.year_month ORDER BY 1
results.after_sql: SELECT d.year_month, sum(m.orders_created), sum(m.orders_delivered), sum(m.gmv) FROM mart.city_daily m JOIN core.dim_date d ON d.date_key = m.date_key GROUP BY d.year_month ORDER BY 1
